sections.title: Right now
lines: Pre-race growth, green flag 1:00pm CT. Sold 20,453, 54,459 resting. Worst line -$525.

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (150+ behind the leader): Chase Briscoe, Christopher Bell, William Byron.
William Byron: 1,912 behind. Steps to 6c at the next check.
Christopher Bell: 1,781 behind. Price 6c matches the crowd.
A price step needs 10 min with no fill and the crowd paying less.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A driver gets a new wave when 90% of what he offered has sold.
Growth phase: waves allowed down to -$2,000 per driver, limited by free cash.
AJ Allmendinger: 3 waves so far, latest 28 @ 2c, 0% filled.
Michael McDowell: 3 waves so far, latest 28 @ 2c, 0% filled.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It stops a driver whose line falls under -$550.
Glide starts 9:00am CT: limit slides from -$550 to +$150 by 1:00pm CT.
Under the limit it trims rows, buys back cheaply, and sells to close gaps from 11:30am CT.
Even-up from 1:00pm CT, last-resort take from 12:40pm CT, green flag 1:00pm CT.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: waves, price steps and the glide run by rule. The worst line may not fully close.
